json.justification: The electric meter (Photo 11) is near an outside corner, and the gas meter and regulator appear to be only a few feet to its left (Photos 2–4, which show the same orange cord and conduit), so the 5 ft gas clearance rules out the stretch near the meter. Around the corner, the wall is a cantilevered bump-out raised over rocks with ground-floor shuttered windows (Photos 12–15), and farther along the gas-meter wall there are windows, an AC condenser and a fence (Photos 1, 6–9). No placement clearly meets the gas clearance, the ComEd 3 ft window rule, overhead clearance and routing all at once, so this needs a human look.
